name: AniList ↔ MAL Sync
description: Bidirectional AniList and MyAnimeList synchronization for anime and manga in Seanime.
author: AleBoss72
notes: Requires AniList login in Seanime. MAL OAuth currently uses the upstream MyAnimeListSync OAuth application/callback. Supports anime and manga, live Seanime/AniList → MAL updates, plus manual AniList → MAL and MAL → AniList list synchronization. Based on nnotwen/MyAnimeListSync (MIT).
